_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: The base rate is overwhelmingly coil (97% of windows hold ±2), and neither brain has identified a breaker that has actually fired — ETF flows flipping positive or funding spiking are both still hypothetical, so HOLD with conviction is the skilled call until one of those triggers confirms.
next_move.brains_agree: No — the analyst calls HOLD with low confidence while the narrative implies a bullish accumulation setup; the analyst's forward call edges toward Disbelief but only if breakers fire, while the narrative assumes the bottom is already forming
next_move.confirmed_if: ETF flows sustain >30 for 3+ sessions with funding staying <60
next_move.invalidated_if: Funding spikes >65 with btc_momentum_30d rolling over below 55, signaling leveraged long exhaustion
